ceu: ✦ The trine between Mars and Saturn

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

The trine between Mars and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Mars brings courage and initiative, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Reply to that message you keep leaving for later.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.

The trine between Mars and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Mars brings courage and initiative, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Value your time: do not work for free for people who can pay.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The trine between Mars and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Move your body first thing in the morning, even if it is only a ten-minute walk.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The trine between Mars and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Mars brings courage and initiative, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Help someone quietly, without them knowing it was you.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.

The trine between Mars and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Mars brings courage and initiative, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Share a project of yours with someone who can help.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The trine between Mars and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Mars brings courage and initiative, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.

The trine between Mars and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The trine between Mars and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Mars brings courage and initiative, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The trine between Mars and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Mars brings courage and initiative, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The trine between Mars and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Mars brings courage and initiative, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The trine between Mars and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Mars brings courage and initiative, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The trine between Mars and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Mars brings courage and initiative, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.
